protocol.json.experiment: AnyRSI multi-generation direction comparison, RSIHub evaluator
protocol.json.generation_basis: retain previously requested 5 generations; reference arm is prepared but not implicitly added to paid work
protocol.json.inheritance: each arm uses its previous admitted snapshot; keep parent after no gain or ineligible proposals
protocol.json.train_role: one complete 50-task iteration per distinct parent per epoch; share only same-parent/same-epoch evidence
protocol.json.gate_role: 19 fixed tasks, one trial per task in each scoring attempt; fresh confirmation before inheritance
protocol.json.final_role: lock best gate version of each arm before post-freeze scoring on all 89; report 50 train, 19 gate, 20 sealed and 89 overall
protocol.json.shared_initial_results: fresh native-train and native-gate genesis only; single-step pilot scores not imported
protocol.json.comparison_limits: Terra rather than GPT-5.4; local seed-0 parity split, not proof of unpublished paper memberships; shared banks bound trial slots, not equal total token cost
